nom: Viking Revolution Microdermabrasion Face Scrub for Men - Facial Cleanser for Skin Exfoliating

avis.titre: Perfect small grit cleanserPerfect small grit cleanser
avis.texte: I’ve been using this for over a year and love it. It’s got small grit in it to help exfoliate along with the salicylic acid, helps clear pores and remove some oil too. Mellow smell. I use it a few times a week. Ingredients: Aqua, Butylene Glycol, Trehalose, Cetearyl Olivate, Sorbitan Olivate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Portulaca Oleracea Extract, Cellulose, Tapioca Starch, Sucrose, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Xanthan Gum, Benzyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Salicylic Acid, Sorbic Acid.

avis.titre: Overall, a solid facial scrub that works well for regular exfoliation.
avis.texte: This face scrub has a nice texture that feels exfoliating without being harsh. It lathers well and leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed after use. The scent is subtle and not overpowering. Texture: Gentle but effective exfoliation. Cleanliness: Leaves skin feeling clean and smooth. Effectiveness: Helps clear dullness and rough patches. Scent: Light and pleasant. Skin feel: Doesn’t dry out my skin after rinsing. Value for money: Good quality for the price. Overall, a solid facial scrub that works well for regular exfoliation.

avis.titre: Effective Exfoliation—A Great Option for Men’s Skincare
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Viking Revolution Microdermabrasion Face Scrub, and overall, it’s been a great addition to my skincare routine. It provides effective exfoliation and leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed. The scrub has a nice texture and isn’t too harsh on my face. The only reason I’m giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that the scent could be a little more pleasant, but the results are fantastic. I’d still recommend it for anyone looking for an affordable and effective face scrub!

Giving it a solid 3.5 stars - Really wanted to love the product: they've got a cool name, packaging, value, even comes with coupon for future orders. Feels great on my face, not super abrasive... Two big things for me is the Scent - literally smells like a match stick seconds after lighting, sorta pleasant but not really... tolerable if I hold my breath and wash quickly. The other is a brief "film" that's left behind no matter how much I rinse... mostly on my hands. Once dried off, skin feels good. It's worth trying...just not sure if I'll buy more, even with the coupon.

avis.titre: Who would have thought. I didn't ever think about it
avis.texte: I got out of the shower patted face and exfoliated my face with this scrub on day one of my "every other evening shaving" routine. Let's just say I was just amazed about the scrub ability to remove dirt, build up without irritation. After rinsing this product off my face I felt the difference in skin health and after shaving with layers and Vikings balm it feels like a new face and smooth as well.
Smells great and feels great when you touch his skin. He loves it!
This is a very nice official scrub. You feel quite refreshed using this product. Happy to recommend this product. As well as the seller.

I never had to use face stuff before. However, after moving to Germany (where the water is a lot harder) my scalp and face started feeling itchy and peeled more. My partner who did know about this stuff gave me fancy expensive Asian stuff. Worked like a charm, but very expensive, and I didn't want to waste her stuff on me. I tried some other men's products, for example L'Oréal for men, the charcoal one, horrible stuff.. After seeing this come by somewhere I figured I'd give it a try, but didn't have high hopes seeing all the others 'mens' products from known brands are pretty terrible, but was pleasantly surprised. It actually has a good peeling effect and has no weird residue or odd feeling on your face afterward. It smells nice and feels like it even rehydrates my skin a bit instead of drying it out further. Can recommend!

avis.titre: Viking Revolution transformed my facial care regime!
avis.texte: I don't have an epic beard like many of Viking Revolution's customers do, but I tried their facial scrub anyway because the brand I was using was discontinued. Let me just say that "I love Viking Revolution!" Not only does this product smell good (my wife keeps raving about how great the scent is), but I love how just a dab lathers up nicely and actually moisturizes my skin. My face tends to get dried out in the winter, and this is revitalizing my skin with all the natural oils they use in this product. But the best part is my face doesn't feel oily afterwards, just wonderfully hydrated and relieved! I also like that I can actually feel the little beads inside the cleanser exfoliating my skin, which also leaves me feeling refreshed and clean. I can't thank Viking Revolution enough for making this awesome product! And the price point is great too, especially since your bottle is bigger than most others on the market! I'll definitely be buying more and telling all my friends to try it.

I don’t like the fact that the company advertised this product as being “organic.” That was the main selling point for me to try this product, but I was duped. I attached a photo to show you the actual ingredients. However, upon using this face wash, I was somewhat impressed with the microdermabrasion scrubbing power this stuff has. If it were actually organic, I’d continue buying this product, but I think I’m going to keep looking.
